transport_dispositions.note: Legacy required events stay in the events array. Recording Requested is documented here with request_origin semantics. It is not inserted into events[] in this change because the registry generator would also rewrite app/lib/utils/analytics/registry/events.g.dart, which is outside the admin and analytics write boundary. Parent regenerates that Dart file if the event is later promoted into events[].

recording_requested.consumer: PostHog capture-session preparation. explicit_user only for the user-attempt funnel.
recording_requested.semantics: Preparing a capture session emits Recording Requested, including automatic session rolls. The capture controller completes the previous session with reason session_roll and prepares the next one. request_origin=explicit_user is a proven user attempt. automatic_roll is not a user attempt. unknown is used when caller intent is not proven. Do not infer user intent from the event's existence.
